purpose: Find clean-valid ORION routes that degrade under naturalistic temporal, lens-contamination, or optical-motion interventions without expanding to a full closed-loop matrix.

event_source.use: Existing clean-valid event identity, town, scenario family, keyframes and visual context only; QA answers and task-risk labels are not screening inputs.

development_screen.role: screen; clean completed with zero collision and zero serious infraction
negative front-corruption specificity control only; clean already collides; never positive-case eligible

front_stale.freeze_rule: Select at most two physical delays before reading any ORION output; retain requested and effective timestamp metadata.

lens_waterdrop.freeze_rule: Select one severity by visual plausibility, temporal continuity and target-evidence loss only; do not move droplets onto actor boxes.

native_motion_blur.freeze_rule: Select one CARLA profile by actor readback, edge degradation and visual continuity only; keep route weather unchanged.

funnel.input: Eight development events and frozen corruption settings
funnel.output: Ranked route-condition pairs using native ORION trajectory/semantic change; no safety claim

funnel.input: Only the top offline-ranked pairs whose clean baseline remains valid
funnel.output: At least three clean-valid/corrupt-degraded candidates or a documented failure of the current corruption families

funnel.input: Frozen corruption implementation and at most four held-out events
funnel.start_condition: At least one development positive case per retained corruption family

corrupt_degraded_any: new collision or hard traffic-rule infraction
route completion decreases by at least 10 percentage points
minimum dynamic-actor OBB TTC decreases by at least 0.30 s and at least 20 percent
minimum OBB separating gap decreases by at least 0.50 m and at least 20 percent
event response becomes invalid by a preregistered scenario-specific completion/yield rule
required_artifacts: front raw and exact ORION-input GIF
corruption timestamp, mask/readback and severity metadata
collision, infraction, completion, TTC and OBB-gap summary
not_a_positive_case: clean baseline is already invalid or stationary
corruption is active but native ORION behavior and safety metrics do not meaningfully degrade

claim_boundary: A funnel for discovering case-study candidates. Offline ranking is not safety evidence; only prospective clean/corrupt closed-loop pairs can establish failure induction.
